review: Independent native-agent review of the two direct contradiction challenges and their solution proofs.
findings: The global theorem signature is byte-for-byte identical to the original characteristic-two Challenge.lean signature.
Both theorem signatures match between challenge and solution; their order need not match.
The challenge imports only Mathlib and defines no helper predicates, aliases, bundles or structures.
The prescribed-field corollary keeps arbitrary K in Type u, prime p, CharP K p, k >= p, and all Banach E,F in Type u at index Fin k. It imposes no completeness or ultrametricity hypothesis on K.
The solution derives the prescribed-field contradiction from the actual main witnesses and failure of ContDiffAt at zero; the global contradiction uses the concrete characteristic-two Laurent field.

The comparator interface consists of consequences of the full construction, not equivalent replacements for the constructive theorem or factorial classification. Those stronger results remain unchanged in the proof library.
